fusions.name: Bedrock Shatter
fusions.desc: Drives the blade into the ground and sends a fissure out to 6 tiles that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts into jagged stone, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Whetstone Passes
fusions.desc: A honed cut that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Planted Point-Down
fusions.desc: Drives the blade into the ground, and the ground holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Chipped Flint
fusions.desc: Conjures a blade of knapped stone. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, and every strike with it makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
